points.description: The answer conveys that the algorithm must actually be implemented (written as a working program) so that it can be run.
The answer conveys that the implemented algorithm is run and its physical (real, wall-clock) running time is measured, rather than estimated or counted theoretically.

rubric.notes: Full marks (5) for an answer that says the algorithm is implemented and its actual running time is measured by running it. Award P1 alone (2) if the student only mentions implementing or coding the algorithm without measuring its running time. Award P2 alone (3) only if the student clearly conveys running it and timing it, which implies implementation. Answers that describe theoretical analysis, Big-O counting, or mathematical estimation earn no marks.
